java.say: Animal is an interface: it promises the method makeSound(), but has no code for it.
Every class that implements Animal must have this method.
Lion keeps the promise in its own way.
Penguin keeps the same promise in another way. Code that only knows Animal can use both.

cpp.say: C++ has no interface keyword. Animal is a class with only a pure virtual method (= 0): a promise without code.
Every class that implements Animal must have this method.
Lion keeps the promise in its own way.
Penguin keeps the same promise in another way. Code that only knows Animal can use both.
